title: DSFlow: A Neuro-Symbolic Data Workflow Agent with Statistical Diagnostic Guardrails
abstract: arXiv:2611.25111v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Data science workflows often require tools that presume non-trivial technical knowledge. Large language models (LLMs) reduce this barrier, but a gap remains between flexible general-purpose agents and statistically controlled pipelines. We introduce DSFlow, a LangGraph-based neuro-symbolic data-agent platform that combines reusable, LLM-selected skills with deterministic diagnostic guardrails. Skills provide extensible task knowledge. Symbolic validation can accept a proposed method, request clarification or replanning, override an unsuitable method, or supply a safe fallback. Regression and clustering case studies illustrate how DSFlow uses diagnostic evidence to correct method choices and documents those decisions in auditable reports.

translated_title: DSFlow：一种具有统计诊断防护栏的神经符号数据工作流智能体
translated_abstract: 数据科学工作流通常需要使用者具备相当的技术知识才能使用相关工具。大型语言模型（LLM）降低了这一门槛，但在灵活的通用智能体与统计上受控的流水线之间仍然存在差距。我们提出了DSFlow，一个基于LangGraph的神经符号数据智能体平台，它将可复用的、由LLM选择的技能与确定性的诊断防护栏相结合。技能提供可扩展的任务知识。符号验证可以接受提议的方法、请求澄清或重新规划、否决不合适的方法，或提供安全的回退方案。回归和聚类案例研究展示了DSFlow如何利用诊断证据来纠正方法选择，并将这些决策记录在可审计的报告中。
tldr: DSFlow是一个基于LangGraph的神经符号数据科学智能体平台，通过将LLM选择的可复用技能与确定性统计诊断防护栏相结合，能够自动纠正不合适的方法选择并生成可审计的决策报告。
en_tdlr: DSFlow is a LangGraph-based neuro-symbolic data science agent that combines LLM-selected reusable skills with deterministic statistical diagnostic guardrails, enabling automatic correction of unsuitable method choices with auditable decision reports.
